_notes: Read from the tournament savegame: infinite bag af6cfa > bag 541533. Blackbeard's deck is sheet 2 (CardIDs 200-229, 8x4), a sheet of its own; the deck object holds 32 cards: the 30 playing cards, the loose rules card 500 (sheet 5, one image: `tts.extra_card_ids` in the overlay makes tools/import_save.py skip it) and the character card 362 (sheet 3, index 62). The bag also holds a loose CardCustom d0e886 (CardID 17600 of a one-image sheet 176): the same rules card, not a playing card; nothing uses it.

The Sea Dogs are the Custom_Tokens nicknamed Hands (e815fe) and Caesar (265d90): 1 life, no dial. The Treasury is a Custom_Token (442da0) and the doubloons a Custom_Token_Stack (a3b09d, Number 3: three coins in one stack). The session does NOT read coins from the table: the engine keeps the count (counters doubloons and treasury), the chat says every change and the bot moves the coins (session_blackbeard, lua_blackbeard.set_doubloons; docs/heroes/blackbeard.md, Table).

token_slots: where the Treasury tile and the doubloon stack rest on each side. Blackbeard has no sidekick dial nor counter dial, so the column the sidekick dials use is free; the spots are the ones measured live for Abe Sapien's Intuition tokens on that same column (x -3.1 / 1.7, z 18.0 / 20.4). verify_live: not yet seen with these tokens.

The tokens are called treasury_tile and doubloon_stack, not treasury and doubloon: the engine's counters are `treasury` and `doubloons`, and the session gives an ability counter that shares its name with a token a copy of that token per point (session_translators `_counter_bot`, Abe's Intuition tokens), which would clone the Treasury tile.
